body.intent: Fix An owner-run plan's gate leaves its change sets proposed even when rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto, and the Inbox doesn't list them (it lists proposals only when accept is owner), so a planned milestone silently stalls. Seen 2026-11-05: milestone 28's five web UI change sets sat proposed after plan PR #309 merged; the Inbox said nothing waits. Owner: "Yes those should never have been waiting for my acceptance". Milestone planning needs the owner (interview), but acceptance follows rhiza.autonomy.accept: with accept auto, the gate accepts what an owner-run plan proposed, as it does for autonomous plans; with accept owner, the proposals are listed in the Inbox as now.
